summary: End-to-end smoke test of StoryForge complete. 11/11 backend pytest cases pass (dashboard, router-status, stories list/detail, channels, social/credentials, social youtube auth-url, final MP4 media, thumbnail, audio segment, book OCR status). Frontend: Dashboard, Story Studio (6aa5425390b47295cfe96a16), Story Library, News Desk, Engagement/Social, Channels/Settings and Upload pages all render and function. Full review flow tested: Request Edits -> status flips to 'Edits Requested' + produce-video-cta appears; Approve -> status flips to 'Approved' + publish-panel appears with YouTube+Instagram buttons. Channel voice save round-trip works (gemini:Charon -> gemini:Puck -> back to gemini:Charon, API PATCH 200). Book 6aa57126cf9d4dc77f7ff483 still ocr_running (progress 2%) as expected.

minor.issue: Initial test run experienced 3 transient 30s read-timeouts against tale-video-engine.preview.emergentagent.com for /api/dashboard, /api/router-status, /api/stories. Immediate retry succeeded (200 in <200ms). Suggests occasional edge/proxy cold-start latency; internal localhost:8001 is fast (<10ms).

ui_bugs.issue: Missing data-testid='social-cred-youtube' on the YouTube credentials status card (the card is rendered and visible, but the testid specified in the review request is absent).
Missing data-testid='dropzone' on the PDF drop area (the dropzone element is rendered and visible with 'Drop a scanned PDF book here', but the testid is absent).
No user-facing success toast/confirmation observed after saving channel settings (API returns 200, state persists, but DOM does not surface a 'Saved' toast).
React console warning: 'Each child in a list should have a unique key prop. Check the render method of DashboardPage.' Non-blocking but should be fixed.

integration_issues.issue: Currently 0 stories are in 'script_ready' state (status_counts: 13 draft, 2 rendering, 1 in_review/approved, 1 failed), so the 'Script Ready' filter yields an empty table and produce-selected-button stays disabled. This is expected behavior given seed data, but the produce-selected flow could not be exercised end-to-end during this run.

action_items: Add data-testid='social-cred-youtube' to the YouTube credentials status card on /social.
Add data-testid='dropzone' to the PDF upload dropzone on /upload.
Surface a visible success toast after channel settings save on /settings.
Fix the missing key prop warning in DashboardPage list render (likely jobs-table or recent-stories map).
Seed at least a few 'script_ready' stories so the Library curation Produce Selected flow can be validated end-to-end.
(Info) Book 6aa57126cf9d4dc77f7ff483 is still ocr_running at 2% (page cap = 150/run); progress advancement will need another OCR run to complete.
critical_code_review_comments: Dashboard stat 'stat-stories' shows 0 while /api/stories returns 17 items; label says 'extracted from PDFs' so it likely filters book-derived stories only. Consider clarifying label or exposing a total-stories stat to avoid confusion.

Review approve button click required scroll-into-view before it registered on first attempt — likely due to sticky footer overlay; consider ensuring the review action bar is not intercepting pointer events when off-viewport.
No user-facing loading/success/error toast on channel save; per app-wide standard every API call should have success/error UI state.

success_rate.frontend: ~92% (all core flows work; 3 minor testid/UX gaps)

seed_data_creation: None. Existing seed (story 6aa5425390b47295cfe96a16, book 6aa57126cf9d4dc77f7ff483, news items) used.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 11 pytest cases live in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py and run under 10s. Story 6aa5425390b47295cfe96a16 was left in status='approved' after review flow; if you need it in 'in_review' or 'edits_requested' again, POST to /api/stories/{id}/review. Book 6aa57126cf9d4dc77f7ff483 still ocr_running at 2%; another OCR run is needed to advance it to segmented. To exercise the Library curation produce-selected flow, first generate scripts on at least 2 draft stories so they reach 'script_ready'.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A - no critical bugs. Transient 30s timeouts on public URL were resolved on retry (edge/proxy latency, not an app defect). Minor UX gaps (missing testids, missing toast, key warning) are cosmetic.
